title: Negated-prop falsification classifier for still-sampled verdicts
purpose: Provides a scored classifier distinguishing four negated-prop compliance patterns (always_present, sometimes_present, never_present, ambiguous_only) from a list of per-still verdicts. Operationalises the HF-PKG-014 finding in art_01M6A5NN0JFR92YNZ3YG1V3B85 r1 where a negated prop appeared in every sampled still. Complements Delta's sampling-coverage audit (7ae60924) and Forge's deviation log (99fb4501) without duplicating either.
